rawUserRequest: Continue the active thread goal: investigate residual Work Items, repair them in the current Work Item where possible, write any required authorization into the Contract, and ensure Outcome is directly visible with its traffic-light marker.

declaredIntent.summary: Remove the two stale active reader duplicates and deliver the fail-closed cleanup guard correction on the current main base.

intent.problem: The current origin/main still contains documentation-current-revision-reader-validation.handoff.json and receipt.json under active/, even though the corresponding reader Work Item is archived with resolved event evidence. The old cleanup PR is stale and unmerged, so the repository also lacks its bounded deletion approval seam and v2 baseline compatibility correction.
constraints: Delete only the two exact active duplicate paths after the Contract and Summary bind the approved destructive change.
Keep the archived reader Contract, Summary, Outcome, Manifest, event log, timestamps, bindings, and comprehension result byte-for-byte unchanged.
Repair the backtrack guard in this Work Item so only an approved Contract policy plus explicit Summary destructiveChanges can allow Work Item evidence deletion.
Accept v2 object-shaped baselineDirtyPaths in changed-critical coverage while retaining fail-closed ownership checks.
Do not merge stale PR #879 or #883; preserve their historical evidence and record their disposition rather than rewriting it.
The active Outcome must be directly delivered in the conversation and include the canonical 🔴🟡🟢 marker before archive.
intent.rationale: The root defect is not merely leftover files: the cleanup delivery never reached current main, and the deletion guard did not encode the approved exception. Delivering both the exact cleanup and its guard correction from the current base restores the lifecycle invariant without weakening fail-closed behavior.

problemStatement: Current origin/main retains two active reader receipt duplicates even though their immutable archived Work Item evidence is resolved; the stale cleanup delivery was never merged.

riskAssessment.reason: The WI removes two active evidence duplicates and changes a deletion guard; exact paths and immutable archive boundaries are explicitly declared.

acceptance: The two exact documentation-current-revision-reader-validation active duplicates are removed, while the archived Contract, Summary, Outcome, Manifest, event log, and comprehension evidence remain byte-for-byte unchanged.
The backtrack guard authorizes Work Item evidence deletion only when the active Contract has an approved destructiveChangePolicy and the Summary explicitly declares the exact delete paths.
Regression tests cover authorized deletion, fail-closed unapproved deletion, malformed authorization, and the v2 object-shaped baselineDirtyPaths record.
Current-main active inventory contains no handoff or receipt record for the completed reader Work Item after the cleanup.
The active Outcome is persisted, directly delivered in the conversation as a complete report beginning with Outcome: 🔴, Outcome: 🟡, or Outcome: 🟢, and only a green completed Outcome permits archive.
The stale #879 and #883 delivery identities are dispositioned without merging stale branches or rewriting immutable predecessor evidence.
No release, tag, product source, unrelated documentation, or unrelated Work Item evidence is changed.
